question: Which of the following is NOT a non-renewable resource?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Solar Energy**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Solar Energy** is a renewable resource, unlike natural gas, liquefied petroleum gas, and coal, which are non-renewable resources.
 
• Renewable resources are those that can be replenished naturally over short periods of time.
 
• Solar energy is harnessed from the sun and does not deplete over time, making it a sustainable source of energy.
 
• Non-renewable resources, on the other hand, are finite and will eventually run out.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Natural Gas**, **Liquefied Petroleum Gas**, and **Coal** are fossil fuels that are formed from the remains of ancient plants and animals over millions of years.
 
• The use of non-renewable resources has environmental impacts, including greenhouse gas emissions and pollution.
 
• Transitioning to renewable energy sources like solar energy can help reduce the carbon footprint and combat climate change.
 
• Investing in renewable energy also promotes energy security and sustainability for future generations.
